description: This file contains utility functions for exporting dashboard configurations to various formats such as HTML, PDF, and PowerPoint. It includes functions for rendering dashboards to HTML via Jinja2 templates, generating PDFs using FPDF library, and creating PowerPoint presentations with python-pptx. The file also imports libraries for PDF manipulation like PyMuPDF (fitz) which may be used elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: str dashboard_to_html(dashboard_config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Renders a dashboard configuration dictionary to an HTML string using Jinja2 templating.

methods.name: generate_pdf_from_html(html: str, pdf_path: str)
methods.description: Creates a PDF file from an HTML string. Currently, it adds the HTML as plain text to the PDF.

methods.name: generate_ppt_from_dashboard(dashboard_config: Dict[str, Any], ppt_path: str)
methods.description: Generates a PowerPoint presentation from a dashboard configuration dictionary, creating a slide for each widget.
